name: ecommerce-seo-optimizer
description: Audit and optimize e-commerce product listings at scale. Validates titles, descriptions, pricing, image alt tags, and exports keyword-optimized catalogs.

paragraphs: A practical tool for e-commerce teams and SEO specialists to audit and improve on-page product listings at scale. Built with Python, Pandas, and Streamlit: upload a product catalog, see every title/description/image/price issue, review keyword-aware suggestions, and export an optimized copy — original columns are always preserved.
features: Upload CSV or XLSX product catalogs (title, description, price, category, brand, image columns recognized and normalized)
Audit engine: empty/short/long titles, empty/short descriptions, missing prices, missing or malformed image URLs, duplicate titles
Suggestion engine: expands short titles with brand/category keywords, generates description copy, records reasons for every change
Safe apply: writes optimizedtitle, optimizeddescription, optimized columns without overwriting originals
